items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: she's a good banjo player for what I need as any I've ever had

ctx.x: Is she a strong banjo player would you say?

I'll tell you what, she's a good banjo player for what I need as any I've ever had. She's not strong as far as power, sheer power. But then again I don't have a powerful band, I don't have a loud band. But she's one of the best rhythm banjo players that I've ever heard in my life. And how long has she been playing? She's only been playing about three years, totally. She just has that knack, Richard. And the longer she plays the better she will get. She's one of those kind of people who just started late in life.…
Well fifteen years old and he's been playing for more than three years. Yeah. And he's been... Probably since he was a kid.
